statement: Whenever find_array(pref) returns a result r, len(r) = n and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, xor(r[0..i]) = pref[i], where xor(r[0..i]) denotes the bitwise xor r[0] bitwise-xor r[1] bitwise-xor ... bitwise-xor r[i]. For i = 0 this means xor(r[0..0]) = r[0].
preconditions: Let n = len(pref). Assume 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= pref[i] <= 1000000.

statement: For every pref satisfying the preconditions, find_array(pref) returns a result. It does not fail: there is no panic, no out-of-bounds access, and no arithmetic overflow.
preconditions: Let n = len(pref). Assume 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= pref[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Whenever find_array(pref) returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < n, if i = 0 then r[i] = pref[0], and if i > 0 then r[i] = pref[i] bitwise-xor pref[i-1].
preconditions: Let n = len(pref). Assume 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= pref[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Whenever find_array(pref) returns a result r, for every i with 2 <= i < n, (r[i] bitwise-xor r[i-1]) = (pref[i] bitwise-xor pref[i-2]).
preconditions: Let n = len(pref). Assume 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= pref[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Whenever find_array(pref) returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= r[i] <= 1048575, that is, r[i] <= 2^20 - 1.
preconditions: Let n = len(pref). Assume 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= pref[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Whenever find_array(pref) returns a result r, for every array q of length n of 64-bit integers such that xor(q[0..i]) = pref[i] for every i with 0 <= i < n, it holds that q[i] = r[i] for every i with 0 <= i < n.
preconditions: Let n = len(pref). Assume 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= pref[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Whenever find_array(pref) returns a result r, for every i with 1 <= i < n, if pref[i] = pref[i-1], then r[i] = 0.
preconditions: Let n = len(pref). Assume 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= pref[i] <= 1000000.

statement: Whenever find_array(pref) returns a result r, for every i with 1 <= i < n, r[i] bitwise-xor pref[i-1] = pref[i].
preconditions: Let n = len(pref). Assume 1 <= n <= 100000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= pref[i] <= 1000000.
